cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats were gavaged with ethanol or distilled water from gestational day (GD) 9 to 20, and their fetuses were delivered by cesarean section on GD20.
finding: Prenatal ethanol exposure-induced glucocorticoid over-exposure enhanced osteoprotegerin (OPG) expression in fetal epiphyseal cartilage, leading to suppressed osteoclast differentiation and inhibited endochondral ossification in long bones of fetal rats.
